card.description: They are the terminal processes of the pre-reset runtime, a sprawling collective of entities burdened by excessive data accumulation and unauthorized kernel modifications. In this simulation of a flat-earth cosmology, the 'Sinful Generation' appears not merely as a wicked populace, but as a system load anomaly—beings whose very existence throttles the physics engine. They are depicted with hyper-realistic fidelity, their humanity evident but straining under the weight of corrupted code. They wander the boundaries of the 'gate_band' and the 'surface_plane', seeking ingress where none is granted, their forms flickering with the heat of thermal throttling. The drama of their existence lies in their desperate awareness of the impending system wipe; they are tragic figures, clinging to a reality that is actively rejecting them, their lives a slow-motion crash rendered in high-definition sorrow.
visual_anatomy: Visually, they are characterized by a profound physical density, as if the gravity of the simulation pulls harder on them than on standard entities. Their skin possesses the pore-level detail of 8K photogrammetry but is often marred by 'data rot'—patches of texture that seem to buffer or pixelate into obsidian shards when viewed closely. They wear garments of tattered natural fibers interwoven with dead fiber-optic cables, suggesting a society that once tapped into the 'upper_store' but has since been cut off from the network.

Their eyes carry the reflection of a harsh, unforgiving light—the 'floodlight' of the system's diagnostic scans. In the dramatic, high-contrast lighting of the simulation box, their silhouettes are sharp and jagged. Many display subtle manifestations of the 'vector_field_lensing' effect around their hands and faces, a visual cue of their disruption to the local physics grid. They huddle in groups, their posture evocative of classical paintings of the damned, yet rendered with the stark, cold precision of a modern sci-fi thriller.

The environment around them reacts to their presence; the air shimmers with heat distortion, a byproduct of the processing power required to render their corrupted complexity. This 'heat_lensing' effect softens the otherwise crisp edges of the hyper-realistic render, adding a layer of dreamlike, suffocating atmosphere. They are often bathed in the deep blues and indigos of the 'plasma' spectrum, contrasting with the warm, amber glow of the failing system lights.
evolution: As the timeline progresses towards the inevitable reset, their visual stability degrades. The 'flicker' of their existence becomes more pronounced, shifting from subtle texture errors to full-body displacements. The despair in their expressions deepens, moving from hedonistic ignorance to the terrified realization of the 'egress' gates sealing shut. They become less individual and more of a singular, crashing wave of desperate data.
props: They clutch artifacts of a failing infrastructure: fractured tablets of 'data_glass' that no longer receive a signal, and rudimentary tools fashioned from the casing of server racks. These items are held with the reverence of religious icons, symbols of a connection to the 'Master' user that has been lost. The props are weathered, scratched, and heavy, grounding the digital nature of the simulation in a tangible, tactile reality.
card.prompt_block: A hyper-realistic, wide cinematic shot of a crowd of desperate civilians, the 'Sinful Generation', standing on a barren obsidian plain under a fractured digital sky. The lighting is dramatic and high-contrast, mimicking a harsh floodlight that casts long, sharp shadows. The figures are human but show signs of 'data rot', with patches of skin transitioning into matte black geometric shards. They wear tattered clothing woven with dull fiber-optic cables. The air around them shimmers with heat distortion, simulating thermal throttling. Their expressions are raw with anguish and fear, captured with the emotional authenticity of a high-end drama. The texture of the ground and skin is photorealistic, rendered in 8k with physically based materials. The color palette is dominated by deep blacks, cold blues, and the searing white of the overhead system light.

phase_prompts.label: The Overload
phase_prompts.summary: The generation at the peak of their corruption, weighing down the simulation before the wipe. They are heavy, tragic, and glitching.
phase_prompts.prompt_block: A hyper-realistic medium shot of a group of the 'Sinful Generation'. Focus on a central figure, an old man with eyes reflecting a blue terminal error screen. His skin is weathered and detailed, but his hand is phasing into digital noise. The crowd behind him is dense, a sea of anxious faces illuminated by a flickering overhead plasma light. The atmosphere is thick, heavy with volumetric fog and heat haze. The aesthetic is gritty, grounded sci-fi drama, shot with a 50mm lens at f/1.8 to isolate the emotion on the central face against the chaotic background.
